-- ── Core Device Tables ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS devices (
  id           serial PRIMARY KEY,
  device_id    text,
  uid          text UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name         text NOT NULL,
  type         text DEFAULT 'relay',
  location     text,
  enabled      boolean DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS device_readings (
  id               bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  device_uid       text NOT NULL,
  recorded_at      timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  relay_status_r1  boolean,
  relay_status_r2  boolean,
  relay_status_r3  boolean,
  relay_status_r4  boolean,
  voltage          numeric,
  current          numeric,
  watts_consumed   numeric,
  power_factor     numeric,
  temperature_f    numeric,
  rssi             numeric,
  battery_v        numeric,
  firmware_version text,
  location         text
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_device_readings_uid_time ON device_readings(device_uid, recorded_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS device_events (
  id              bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  device_uid      text NOT NULL,
  event_id        integer,
  event_time      timestamptz,
  received_at     timestamptz DEFAULT now(),

);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oadr3_vtns (
  id                    uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name                  text NOT NULL,
  vtn_url               text NOT NULL,
  auth_type             text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bearer',
  bearer_token          text,
  client_id             text,
  client_secret         text,
  token_url             text,
  access_token          text,
  token_expires_at      timestamptz,
  polling_interval_mins integer DEFAULT 5,
  enabled               boolean DEFAULT true,
  last_polled_at        timestamptz,
  status                text DEFAULT 'unknown',
  created_at            timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oadr3_programs (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  vtn_id          uuid REFERENCES oadr3_vtns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  program_id      text,
  program_name    text,
  ven_name        text,
  ven_id          text,
  target_type     text,
  target_id       text,
  target_name     text,
  control_mode    text DEFAULT 'dlc',
  signal_mapping  jsonb,
  webhook_enabled boolean DEFAULT false,
  webhook_secret  text,
  enabled         boolean DEFAULT true,
  created_at      timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oadr3_events (
  id           uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  vtn_id       uuid REFERENCES oadr3_vtns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  program_id   text,
  event_id     text,
  event_name   text,
  state        text,
  start_time   timestamptz,
  end_time     timestamptz,
  signal_type  text,
  signal_level numeric,
  payload      jsonb,
  executed     boolean DEFAULT false,
  executed_at  timestamptz,
  created_at   timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oadr3_reports (
  id             uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  vtn_id         uuid REFERENCES oadr3_vtns(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  program_id     text,
  event_id       text,
  report_payload jsonb,
  sent_at        timestamptz,
  response_code  integer,
  created_at     timestamptz DEFAULT now()
